sources.title: Trading off Relevance and Revenue in the Jobs Marketplace: Estimation, Optimization and Auction Design
sources.snippet: We study the problem of position allocation in job marketplaces, where the platform determines the ranking of the jobs for each seeker. The design of ranking mechanisms is critical to marketplace efficiency, as it influences both short-term revenue from promoted job placements and long-term health through sustained seeker engagement.
